**Files created** (in `frontend/src/features/landing/`)
- `sections/Features.tsx` (ring, week bars, dish chips and check-in card), `Buddy.tsx` (with StreakDots), `Faq.tsx`, `Cta.tsx` and `Footer.tsx`.
- `components/FeatureCard.tsx`.

**Files changed**
- `LandingPage.tsx` wires in the new sections.
- `content.ts` holds all the new copy.
- `LandingButton.tsx` gained `limeOutline`, `ink` and `inkOutline` variants and a 60px `xl` size.

**Behaviour**

**Differences from the HTML**

- **Font sizes:** Dish chips, check-in labels, footer links and the footer disclaimer are 16px, where the HTML has 15px. This follows your body-minimum rule.
- **Smaller text:** "kcal left" and the copyright row stay at 14px, as in the HTML. Say if you want them at 16.
- **Estimate label:** The ring label is not visible text. It lives in the accessibility label ("About 950 kcal left today, an estimate"), and the card paragraph already says "always marked as an estimate". A visible "est." would change the copy.
- **Week bars:** The ring and week bars are `accessible` images with labels I wrote (`week.label`, `budget.label`). The HTML has none.
- **Privacy link:** The footer "Privacy" link has no target, as in the HTML (`href="#"`), so it does nothing yet.
- **CTA "Get Hissa":** It scrolls to its own section, which is a no-op.

**Not checked:** the animated parts are intentionally missing, so rotation on FAQ open is instant and the ring is at its final state.

Phase c1 is built. `tsc` and `eslint` are clean, and `expo export --platform web` bundles without errors. I haven't seen any animation run on web, iOS or Android. b2 is committed as d987567, and c1 is uncommitted.

**Reanimated and worklets config**
- There is no `babel.config.js`. `babel-preset-expo` 58 adds the worklets babel plugin by itself when `react-native-worklets` is installed, on both web and native. Reanimated 4.7.1 supports RN 0.88 and worklets 0.13.x, so I added no config.
- **Version mismatch:** `frontend/node_modules` holds worklets 0.13.0 (pinned in `package.json`), but the root `node_modules` has 0.13.1, which Reanimated resolves. Two copies could cause a native version-mismatch error. I didn't install anything. If it shows up, align both to one version.

**Small fix**
- The ring now shows "About" above "950" above "kcal left", which reads "About 950 kcal left". The copy is in `content.ts`, and the accessibility label stays.
- `GET_HISSA_URL` is an empty placeholder in `content.ts`. The Nav, Hero and CTA "Get Hissa" buttons call `openGetHissa` (`getHissa.ts`), which does nothing while the URL is empty.
- Those three buttons no longer scroll to the join section. "Bring your buddy" still does.

**Files created**
- `hooks/useReducedMotion.ts`: web reads the `prefers-reduced-motion` media query on the first frame and listens for changes. Native uses `AccessibilityInfo`, which resolves slightly later, so a native reduced-motion user may see one frame of motion.
- `components/HeroStage.tsx`: the stage moved out of `Hero.tsx`.
- `getHissa.ts`.

**Animations**
All except the ring use Reanimated 4's CSS-style animations and transitions, so web and native share the same code and run off the JS thread. With reduced motion on, each animation's props are omitted and the final state shows.

| Animation | How it works | Reduced motion |
|---|---|---|
| Marquee | The 10 words render twice and slide by one measured row width over 30s, linear, infinite. | Row stays at 0. |
| Hero stage | The disc and two rings pulse on staggered 4s loops. A grey skeleton disc with a light sweep covers the stage until it measures, then fades out over 300ms. | Static, no skeleton. |
| Scan band | It sweeps the full visual height and back (2.4s, alternate). | Rests at its old position. |
| Budget ring | A shared value animates `strokeDashoffset` from 628 to 323 over 2s after a 300ms delay. | Starts at 323. |
| FAQ | Height and icon rotation transition over 250ms. Each answer is measured inside a clipped wrapper, so nothing jumps. | Instant. |

The FAQ row keeps its 72px minimum height and `accessibilityState={{ expanded }}`. Closed answers are hidden from screen readers.

**Unsure**
- **Native animation props:** The CSS-style props (`animationName`, `transitionProperty`) are new in Reanimated 4. They type-check and bundle for web, but I haven't run them on a device, so check the marquee and FAQ on native first.
- **Skeleton flash:** The hero is already laid out on first paint, so the skeleton may cover it for only one frame before fading.
- **Ring cap:** The ring's round end cap draws a small dot at the start while it is still empty, as in the HTML.

I'd put `rotation={-90}` and `origin="110, 110"` on the animated circle to start the arc at 12 o'clock. On web, react-native-svg turns those into a `transform-origin` DOM attribute, and React's dev check logs it as an invalid property. Expo showed that as the repeated `WebShape.js` ERROR.

I removed both props and rotated the whole `Svg` with `style={{ transform: [{ rotate: '-90deg' }] }}`, which is what the HTML does.

I loaded `/landing` in headless Edge against the dev server. The console is now clean, and the ring's `stroke-dashoffset` was partway through its draw (about 591 on the way down to 323), so the animation runs. `tsc` and `eslint` are clean.

The Reanimated "Reduced motion setting is enabled" line in your paste is a dev-only warning. It means Windows has animations turned off, so you'll see every animation's final state instead of the motion. To see the motion, turn on Settings → Accessibility → Visual effects → Animation effects.

I haven't committed this fix. `expo start` rewrote `frontend/tsconfig.json` again, so I reverted it with `git checkout`.

   - **Side flips:** The robot used to slide across the whole page when switching sides. The flip now happens in a narrow band and the robot is hidden during it.
   - **Anchor arrivals:** The robot stays in the margin until it is nearly at an anchor, is hidden while crossing, then appears at the anchor.
4. **Footer landing under 1200px:** The robot moves in late with no arc and stands inside the wordmark panel. On narrow screens it used to cover the footer links.

**FAQ test (1280 and 1024)**
- Opening the first item grows the page (6678 to 6753 at 1280, 6434 to 6535 at 1024), and the scroll limit grows with it. Closing returns to the original height.

| 390 | 9 of 63 steps | Only the buddy anchor's "12" and "days together". Footer links and the other text are clear. |
| 780 | 11 of 66 | Same two buddy items only. |
| 1024 | 41 of 52 | Only the buddy "12". |

- **Buddy "12":** This is by design, because the robots stand beside the numeral. "days together" overlapped in earlier runs but not in the final ones.

The robot now walks across the page when its side changes instead of teleporting. `tsc` and `eslint` are clean. Only `robot/journey.ts` changed. I haven't committed it, and I've removed the temporary debug hook I used for measuring.

**What the HTML does on a side flip**
It slides the robot across. It blends the side between neighbouring sections with a smoothstep and sets `X = lerp(vw−gx, gx, (1−side)/2)`, so the crossing is continuous but tied to scroll position, not time. It never jumps. My earlier version made it look like a teleport: a steep flip band, with the robot hidden while crossing.

**What I changed**
- **Walking:**
  - The robot's x eases toward its target with exponential smoothing (τ 1.1s, frame-time based).
  - A 240px/s speed floor stops the last stretch crawling.
  - It runs and faces the direction of travel (yaw ±1.2) until it is within 3px of the target, even if scrolling has stopped. It then goes to idle.
- **Anchors:**
  - Hero, buddy and landing positions are walked to the same way.
  - The handshake burst and the cheer wait until it arrives.
  - It snaps only on the very first placement, during the first 1.5s of layout settling, and while invisible.
- **Size:** With a margin, the robot's size now eases over time (τ 0.7s) once it commits to an anchor. It no longer swells while still in the margin, which had pushed it over the window edge.
- **Section sides:** The side is now simply the side of the section nearest the viewport centre. The section order, with the right, left, right, left, right, left, right sides, is unchanged.
- **Part B items:** Items 1 to 3 from last turn are still in place; the changes above are what moved the numbers below.

**What I measured**
At 1280px, jumping from the Idea section (left) to the How section (right), x went 40 → 144 → 455 → 677 → 843 → 960 → 1044 → 1136 → … → 1240 over about 3.3s. It stayed in run mode the whole way and went to idle on arrival.

**FAQ test**
- At 1280, opening an item took the page from 6678 to 6753; at 1024, from 6434 to 6535. Closing returned it.
- At 1280 the robot ended on the wordmark in all three states (closed, open, closed): x offset 0, feet at the expected y.
- At 1024 it ended inside the panel by the narrow-width rule, again with x offset 0.
- After a jump to the bottom the walk takes a few seconds, so I waited 4.5s. A shorter wait caught it mid-walk.

**Overlap by width** (scanned in 110px scroll steps, robot box 0.6 of its height wide)

| Width | Robot shown | Settled overlaps | Overlaps while walking |
|---|---|---|---|
| 390 | 9 of 63 | The buddy "12" only | The "12" during arrival |
| 780 | 11 of 66 | The buddy "12" only | none |
| 1024 | 52 of 52 | Marquee words at the hero exit (scroll 220); "12"; "days together" | "hissa" in the Idea title; "12" on arrival |
| 1280 | 54 of 54 | Marquee at the hero exit; a 1px graze of the "Buddy" eyebrow (the test box is wider than the real robot); "12"; "days together" | "hissa"; a feature card line; the footer "How it works" link on the way to the landing |
| 1440 | 55 of 55 | Marquee at the hero exit; "12"; "days together" | "hissa"; "12"; the footer "How it works" link |

- No real crossing of the window edge at any width. The one flagged step at 1280 (scroll 330) is the robot shrinking in the margin, about 2px over only by the test's wider box.
